## Comparability note

Both Alphabet and Meta report on a calendar fiscal year ending December 31, and both figures are GAAP consolidated operating income from the respective 10-Ks, so the periods and accounting bases are directly comparable. One caveat on interpretation: Meta's FY2022 base is unusually depressed (peak Reality Labs losses and pre-restructuring cost base), which mechanically inflates its two-year margin expansion.

## Calculation

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alphabet | $282,836M | $74,842M | 26.46% | $350,018M | $112,390M | 32.11% | +5.65 |
| Meta | $116,609M | $28,944M | 24.82% | $164,501M | $69,380M | 42.18% | +17.35 |

- Alphabet: FY2022 revenue $282,836M, operating income $74,842M; FY2024 revenue $350,018M, operating income $112,390M [DOC: comparison_data.txt — Alphabet Inc. 10-K FY2022, accession 0001652044-23-000016; 10-K FY2024, accession 0001652044-25-000014]
- Meta: FY2022 revenue $116,609M, operating income $28,944M; FY2024 revenue $164,501M, operating income $69,380M [DOC: comparison_data.txt — Meta Platforms, Inc. 10-K FY2022, accession 0001326801-23-000013; 10-K FY2024, accession 0001326801-25-000017]

Meta expanded its operating margin by 17.35 pp vs. Alphabet's 5.65 pp — a difference of **11.71 percentage points**. Notably, Meta also overtook Alphabet in absolute operating margin over this window (24.8% → 42.2% vs. 26.5% → 32.1%).

ANSWER: Meta, by approximately 11.7 percentage points more (Meta +17.4 pp vs. Alphabet +5.6 pp)
